trace: All retrieved sources agree that Veramoor was founded in 1204, but this date is very poorly established. Tracing the citation chain reveals that every source ultimately derives from a single 2009 genealogy forum post (P5) by a user who explicitly admitted they had no source for the date. P1 cites P5, P2 cites P1, P3 cites P2, and P4 cites P3 — forming a closed citation loop with no independent corroboration. Despite P3 claiming the date is 'well established and frequently cited,' that characterization is misleading: all citations trace back to one unsourced speculation. The date of 1204 should be treated as unverified and not reliably established.
